title: No-friction force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the force F when friction is zero, yielding 37.5 N.

title: Minimum force derivation
description: Important: Applies equilibrium conditions with friction directed up the incline and uses the maximum static friction relation.

title: Maximum force derivation
description: Important: Applies equilibrium conditions with friction directed down the incline and uses the maximum static friction relation.

title: Range expression
description: Essential: States the final range of F as an inequality with correct fractions (400/19 N ≤ F ≤ 800/13 N).

title: Force resolution
description: Important: Correctly resolves forces into components parallel and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Optional: Explicitly calculates the normal force in terms of F and uses it in the friction equation.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect direction for friction (up vs. down) when setting up equations for minimum or maximum force.

title: Friction magnitude mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses kinetic friction formula (μN) without recognizing maximum static friction equals it, or misapplies the friction limit.
